newsitem.title: USA: JDN Realty prices $160 mln debt offering.
newsitem.headline: JDN Realty prices $160 mln debt offering.

text.p: JDN Realty Corp said on Thursday that it has priced a $160 million two-tranche senior unsecured debt offering.

JDN Realty issued $75 million of 6.80 percent seven-year senior unsecured notes maturing on August 1, 2004, and $85 million of 6.95 percent ten-year senior unsecured notes maturing on August 1, 2007, it said.
The seven-year notes were priced at 83 basis points over the current yield for seven-year U.S. Treasury Notes and were sold at 99.670 percent of par to yield 6.860 percent.

The ten-year notes were priced at 95 basis points over the current yield for ten-year U.S. Treasury Notes and were sold at 99.686 percent of par to yield 6.994 percent, the company said in a statement.
The transaction will close on August 4, 1997, and is rated Baa3 from Moody's, BBB- from Standard & Poor's and BBB- from Duff & Phelps, the company said.
Proceeds will be used to prepay a mortgage loan made to a JDN subsidiary and to reduce the outstanding balance on the company's unsecured line of credit, JDN said.
The offering was managed by Merrill Lynch & Co and co-managed by BT Securities Corporation and Smith Barney Inc, JDN said.
